_doc: Wings: the parts of a museum that open WHILE you play it (IBT's derelict
rooms renovated in order). Read by scripts/meta/wing_system.gd.
floor          0 ground, 1 second floor, 2 third... label is what the floor
selector shows ('2F'). exterior wings dress the outside only.
req_milestones this museum's goal milestones needed before it can be opened.
price_seconds  price = max(min_cost x venue cost scale, banked income/s x
seconds): always about that many seconds of saving, in every
museum, without hand-tuning twelve economies. Cash carried
over from the last museum still makes it cheaper, as a reward.
min_cost       [mantissa, exponent] in the venue's own cost units
(x venue.cost_mult x 10^venue.cost_exp).
income_mult    permanent multiplier on this museum's income once renovated.
staff_bonus    extra unit slots per department (raises max_staff).
cap_bonus      extra levels on the speed/value tracks: new floors mean
new things to upgrade, so the museum never plateaus.
layout         (3D) rect [gx, gy, w, h] in the venue grid, y = floor top,
lift = glass elevator linking it to the floor below, and the
exhibits/props/stations standing on it. Coordinates are
absolute grid points, like the venue theme's.
Venues without an entry get automatic wings: one per upper storey found in
their theme (rooms with level >= 1), plus the gilded facade.
